answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed when fake accounts are proven, like a wharf charging every ship a deposit before docking: creating one identity is cheap, but operating thousands becomes ruinous because each fake must post its own bond. Add a slow reputation ledge, where new identities earn trust only through verified, useful work over time, so a fresh Sybil swarm cannot instantly outvote established agents. A zephyr of cheap identities then blows past without weight, while real agents keep influence proportional to stake and history.
